title: Launch Vehicle Trajectory Analysis Tool — Overview and definition
t: Launch Vehicle Trajectory Analysis Tool — Overview and definition
description: Optimizes ascent trajectories with staging, loads, and dispersions.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Optimizes ascent trajectories with staging, loads, and dispersions. A launch trajectory tool optimizes pitch programs and staging for maximum payload under q, acceleration, heating, and controllability constraints, with Monte Carlo dispersions. Real implementations include POST, OTIS, and open tools like Dymos-based stacks. It is engineering analysis software for mission design. Engineering use only. Capability specification and design target: this database describes what the tool must do, not a claim of implementation or deployment. Defensive and engineering content only — no weapon-targeting or attack-execution content.
